description:
A contemporary residential front entry photographed at standing eye level in a centered, slightly off-axis composition that frames both the front door and the adjacent exterior wall. The camera is at a level pitch, roughly five feet in height, with a normal lens capturing the full entry zone from door to adjacent planting corner.

The exterior walls are smooth white or very pale cream stucco — a clean, matte finish with no texture variation. The entry ceiling overhead is natural light oak with visible grain running horizontally, creating a warm contrast against the cool white walls. The floor surface is large-format smooth light grey concrete or limestone pavers, with a natural woven jute doormat placed in front of the door.

The front door is a broad single-panel door finished in natural pale light oak with vertical shiplap-style tongue-and-groove boarding, framed by a matte-black perimeter door frame. A tall vertical matte-black handle bar and a matte-black digital smart lock are mounted on the door face. A full-height narrow sidelight glass panel to the right of the door looks through to trees and a green lawn beyond, admitting natural daylight.

To the right of the door on the white exterior wall, a soft warm glow emanates from a single wall-mounted position, spreading a diffuse wash of warm white light across the plaster surface. Below this wall position, a matte-black square metal planter box on hairpin legs holds a conical dwarf spruce or arborvitae topiary and small white flowering ground cover. At upper right, a branch with white blossoms from an off-frame flowering tree dips into the composition. Low dusty sage-green foliage shrubs grow at ground level to the right.

A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
